fallbackLink: If the button does not open:

verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.intro: Welcome to Ronde! Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
verify.footer: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.intro: Here is your link to sign in to Ronde. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
magicLink.footer: If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your Ronde account. The link expires in 1 hour.
resetPassword.footer: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invites you to {workspace} on Ronde
invitation.intro: {inviter} invites you to join the {workspace} workspace on Ronde, to prepare and run your team meetings together.
invitation.footer: This invitation expires in 7 days. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.
